Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:10:1.hebrew: זו דברי רבי מאיר - מתני', דקתני דעלו פסולין לארץ ישראל, ומשמע דאין כל הארצות בחזקת מיוחסות חוץ מבבל בלבד, כדאמר בריש פירקא (לעיל קידושין דף סט:) דמסייע ליה לרבי אלעזר, דקאמר: ייחס עזרא את בבל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:10:1.english: This is the statement of Rabbi Meir - [Namely,] the Mishnah, which teaches that the unfit [lineages] went up to the Land of Israel, and which implies that not all lands have a presumptive status of unflawed lineage except Babylonia alone, as [the Gemara] said at the beginning of the chapter (above, Kiddushin 69b) that it supports Rabbi Elazar, who said: Ezra purified the lineage of Babylonia.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:11:1.english: [A woman] from Meḥoza - And Meḥoza is not within the borders of Babylonia stated with regard to lineage.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:11:2.hebrew: זו דברי רבי מאיר - מתני', דקתני דעלו פסולין לארץ ישראל, ומשמע דאין כל הארצות בחזקת מיוחסות חוץ מבבל בלבד, כדאמר בריש פירקא (לעיל קידושין דף סט:) דמסייע ליה לרבי אלעזר, דקאמר: ייחס עזרא את בבל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:11:2.english: This is the statement of Rabbi Meir - [This refers to] the Mishnah, which taught that disqualified [families] ascended to the Land of Israel, which implies that not all lands have a presumptive status of pure lineage except Babylonia alone, as [the Gemara] said at the beginning of the chapter (above, Kiddushin 69b) that [the Mishnah] supports Rabbi Elazar, who said: Ezra purified the lineage of Babylonia.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:11:3.hebrew: והא בי רב כהנא לא מתנו לה הכי - משמיה דשמואל, אלא כדאמר לעיל: כל הארצות בחזקת פסולות, ואמר רב יהודה אמר שמואל: כל הארצות עיסה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:11:3.english: And the school of Rav Kahana did not teach it like this - in the name of Shmuel; but rather, as was stated above: “All lands have a presumptive status of disqualification,” and Rav Yehuda said that Shmuel said: “All lands are [like mixed] dough.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:11:4.english: Rav Zevid of Neharde’a - [He] is not the unqualified Rav Zevid.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:13:1.hebrew: וישב ממזר באשדוד - יבדלו הממזרים מהם, וישבו בפני עצמם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:13:1.english: And a mamzer shall dwell in Ashdod - The mamzerim will be separated from them, and they will dwell by themselves.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:13:2.english: The House of Israel shall dwell in tranquility - [This is] the translation of “and he shall dwell.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:13:3.hebrew: דהוו דמיין בה לנוכראין - תרגומו של ממזר. והכי קאמר: וישב העם שהיה מנוכר מגבול ארצו ונטרד כממזר — באשדוד. גם הוא מגבול ארץ ישראל, ויהושע חלקה להם, אע"פ שלא נכבשה בימיו, כדכתיב (יהושע י״ג:א׳): ״אתה זקנת באת בימים והארץ נשארה הרבה מאד לרשתה״, וקא חשיב ואזיל: ״חמשת סרני פלשתים העזתי והאשדודי וגו'״:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:13:3.english: Who were like strangers in it - [This is] the translation of [the word] mamzer. And this is what [the verse] is saying: The people that was estranged from the border of its land and driven away like a mamzer shall dwell in Ashdod. [Ashdod] is also within the border of the Land of Israel, and Joshua apportioned it to them even though it was not conquered in his days, as it is written (Joshua 13:1): “You have grown old, advanced in years, and very much of the land remains to be possessed,” and it goes on to enumerate: “the five lords of the Philistines: the Gazite and the Ashdodite, etc.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:14:1.hebrew: צוורני צוורני - חבורות חבורות. ל"א: קולרין קולרין, והוא לשון "מעשה בקולר של בני אדם" דסוף יבמות (דף קכב.):
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:14:1.english: Neck-chains, neck-chains - Groups upon groups. Another version: Kolarin, kolarin [collars, collars], and this is the phrasing of: “An incident involving a chain-gang of people,” at the end of Yevamot (122a).

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:1.hebrew: גר נושא ממזרת - דקסבר: קהל גרים לא איקרי קהל. והולד ממזר, דכתיב "לו" — הלך אחר פסולו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:1.english: A convert may marry a mamzeret - For he holds that the congregation of converts is not called a congregation. And the offspring is a mamzer, as it is written: “To him” [Deuteronomy 23:3] — follow the flawed [parent].

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:2.english: [A convert] may not marry a mamzeret - He holds that the congregation of converts is called a congregation.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:3.hebrew: ומותרים בכהנת - ואע"פ שהכהנים אסורים בגיורת ומשוחררת וחללה, דקסבר: לא הוזהרו כהנות כשירות להנשא לפסולין — לאותן שהפסול אינו מוזהר עליהן, כגון אלו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:3.english: And are permitted to [marry] the daughter of a priest - And even though [male] priests are forbidden to [marry] a female convert, an emancipated bondwoman, and a ḥalalah; for he holds that fit priestly women were not cautioned against marrying disqualified men — [namely,] to those where the disqualified person is not cautioned regarding them, such as these.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:4.hebrew: חמשה קהלי כתיבי - גבי אזהרת פסולי יוחסין: לא יבא ממזר בקהל ה' (דברים כ״ג:ד׳), לא יבא לו בקהל (שם), לא יבא עמוני ומואבי בקהל (שם), לא יבא להם בקהל (שם), דור שלישי יבא להם בקהל דמצרי ואדומי (שם). וקהל דגבי פצוע דכא (שם) לא חשיב, דלאו מן פסולי יוחסין קא משתעי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:15:4.english: Five congregations are written - Regarding the prohibition of those of disqualified lineage: "A mamzer shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord" (Deuteronomy 23:3); "shall not enter for him into the congregation" (ibid.); "An Ammonite and a Moabite shall not enter into the congregation" (ibid. 4); "shall not enter for them into the congregation" (ibid.); [and] "a third generation... shall enter for them into the congregation" regarding an Egyptian and an Edomite (ibid. 9). And the [mention of] "congregation" regarding one with crushed testicles (ibid. 2) is not counted, because [the verse] is not speaking of those of disqualified lineage.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:1:1.hebrew: היום יושב בחיקו של אברהם - י"א: מת היום; ואם כן, אין זה רב אדא שבגמרא. ונראה, דהא "יושב בחיקו של אברהם אבינו" — שנכנס לברית מילה; וזה רב אדא בר אהבה, שהאריך ימים הרבה משמת רבי עד דורות אחרונים, בימי רב נחמן בר יצחק, כדאמרינן בבבא בתרא (דף כב.):
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:1:1.english: Today he is sitting in the lap of Abraham - Some say [this means that he] died today; and if so, this is not the Rav Adda [who is mentioned] in the Gemara. But it appears [to me] that this [phrase], "sitting in the lap of Abraham our father," [means] that he entered the covenant of circumcision; and this is [the famous] Rav Adda bar Ahava, who lived a very long life from when Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] died until the later generations in the days of Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak, as we say in Bava Batra (22a).

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:3:1.hebrew: צוה ה' ליעקב סביביו צריו - צרים שהיו סובבים אותם בארצם, דהיינו עמון ומואב, שהצירו להם יותר מן הכל, כדאמרינן בחלק (סנהדרין דף צו:): "עמון ומואב שכיני בישי דירושלים היו" — אותם צוה שיהיו סובבים אותם אף בגלותם; כגון הומניא, דכולה דעמונאי היא, כדאמרי' לעיל — הושיבם סנחריב בבבל — והיו מצירים לישראל שבפום נהרא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:3:1.english: The Lord has commanded concerning Jacob, that they that are round about him should be his adversaries - Adversaries who surrounded them in their land, namely Ammon and Moab, who distressed them more than all [others], as we say in [perek] Chelek (Sanhedrin 96b): “Ammon and Moab were evil neighbors of Jerusalem” — them He commanded to surround them even in their exile; such as Homanya, which is entirely [inhabited by] Ammonites, as we said above — Sennacherib settled them in Babylonia — and they would distress the Jews who were in Pum Nahara.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:4:1.english: One said [it was] for good - The prophet was lamenting over him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:4:2.english: And one said [it was] for evil - That it was displeasing in his eyes that [Pelatiah] died an easy death.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:4:3.english: One said: For good - The prophet was wailing over him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:4:4.english: And one said: For evil - That it was displeasing to him that [Pelatiah] died an easy death.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:4:5.english: Of the istandira of Meishan - The ruler of Meishan.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:5:1.english: One who did this good deed - For he saved the exiles from being slaves in servitude.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:7:1.hebrew: איני יודע שאחוריהם אל ההיכל - שהיה במערב העזרה. מה תלמוד לומר ״אחוריהם וגו'״? אחוריהם ממש, כשהוא מפורע — שהיו מתכוונין להראות אחוריהם לגנאי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:7:1.english: Do I not know that their backs were toward the Sanctuary? - For it was in the west of the courtyard. What is the meaning when the verse states: “Their backs, etc.”? Their actual posteriors, when uncovered, for they intended to display their posteriors in contempt.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:7:2.english: He who did this good deed - For he saved the exiles from becoming slaves to servitude.

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:8:1.hebrew: תסתיים דשמואל הוא דאמר לרעה - דשמואל לית ליה הא דאמר דעבדים נשתלחו למישן, מדקאמר: ״לא חשו לה משום עבדות״:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:8:1.english: It may be concluded that it was Shmuel who said [this was] for evil - For Shmuel does not accept that which was said, that slaves were sent to Meishan, since he said: “They were not concerned about it on account of slavery.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:9:1.hebrew: לעולם אימא לך שמואל הוא דאמר לטובה - דאית ליה הא דנשתלחו עבדים למישן. והאי דקאמר ״לא חשו לה משום עבדות״ — שמואל לטעמיה, דאמר: ״עבד שאין לו לרבו רשות עליו — אין קרוי עבד״. והני נמי, מאחר שגזלום מהם ונתייאשו מהם — זהו הפקר, כדאמרינן בגיטין (דף לט:): ״נתייאשתי מפלוני עבדי״, ומשום לשון הפקר נקט לה, דכיון דאתייאש ליה מיניה — פקע ליה רשותיה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:9:1.english: Actually, I could say to you that it was Shmuel who said [it was] for good - For he accepts that [tradition] that slaves were sent to Mishon. And as for that which he said, "They were not concerned with regard to it on account of slave status" — Shmuel [conforms] to his [standard line of] reasoning, as he said: "A slave whose master does not have authority over him is not called a slave." And these [slaves] as well, since [captors] stole them from them and [their masters] despaired of [recovering] them, this is [tantamount to] renunciation of ownership, as we say in Gittin (daf 39b): "[If one says,] 'I have despaired of so-and-so, my slave'"; and it employed this [formulation] as an expression of renunciation, for once he has despaired of him, his authority has lapsed:

Rashi on Kiddushin 72b:9:2.english: And he does not require a bill of manumission - To be permitted [to marry] an Israelite.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 72b:15:1.hebrew: חמשה קהלי כתיבי - פי': גבי אזהרת פסולי יוחסין. אבל קהל דגבי פצוע דכא לא חשיב, דלאו בפסולי יוחסין משתעי. עוד אומר ר"י: משום דלא שייך ביה קהל:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 72b:15:1.english: “Five congregations are written” - Explanation: [This refers to those written] regarding the prohibition of those of flawed lineage. But the [mention of] “congregation” regarding one with crushed testicles [petzua dakka] is not counted, as [the verse] does not deal with those of flawed lineage. Furthermore, the Ri says: Because [the concept of] a congregation is not applicable to him.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 72b:1:1.hebrew: היום יושב בחיקו של אברהם אבינו - פירש בקונטרס: יש אומרים מת, וא"כ אין זה רב אדא בר אהבה שבגמרא. ונראה לומר: "יושב בחיקו של אברהם" — שנכנס לברית מילה; וזה רב אדא בר אהבה שהאריך ימים הרבה, משמת רבי עד דורות אחרונים בימי רב נחמן בר יצחק, כדאמרי' בב"ב (דף כב:). אך ר"י פי', דשני רב אדא בר אהבה הוו:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 72b:1:1.english: "Today he is sitting in the lap of Abraham our forefather" - Rashi explained: Some say [it means that] he died, and if so, this is not the Rav Adda bar Ahava [mentioned throughout] the Gemara. And it seems [preferable] to say [that] "he is sitting in the lap of Abraham" [means] that he entered the covenant of circumcision; and this is [indeed] Rav Adda bar Ahava, who lived a very long life, from when Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] died until the later generations in the days of Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak, as we say in Bava Batra (22b). However, the Ri explained that there were two [different Sages named] Rav Adda bar Ahava.
